chunks: Muhammad b. al-Qasim al-Astarabadi (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. al-Hasan al-Husayni narrated to us from al-Hasan b. Ali from his father from Muhammad b. Ali from his father al-Rida from his father Musa b. Ja'far from his father Ja'far b. Muhammad from his father Muhammad b. Ali from his father Ali b. al-Husayn from his father al-Husayn b. Ali (peace be upon them). He said:

Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: How many a heedless person weaves a garment to wear, when it is actually his shroud; and builds a house to live in, when it is actually the place of his grave.

key_terms.أمير المؤمنين: Commander of the Faithful — the exclusive title of Imam Ali (AS)
key_terms.غافل: heedless/negligent — one who is oblivious to the reality of death and the afterlife
key_terms.قبر: grave — the final resting place, a recurring motif in Islamic exhortations about mortality
key_terms.كفن: shroud/burial cloth — the garment in which the deceased is wrapped for burial

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about heedless people and death?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Amali of Shaykh al-Saduq, transmitted through the Golden Chain (silsilat al-dhahab) through all twelve Imams, Imam Ali (AS) delivers a pithy reminder about the transience of worldly life. He warns that many people who are absorbed in material pursuits — weaving clothes and building homes — are unknowingly preparing for their own death, as those garments may become their burial shrouds and those homes the sites of their graves. This saying encapsulates a core Shi'i ethical theme about remembrance of death (dhikr al-mawt) as a corrective to heedlessness (ghafla).

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Qasim al-Astarabadi (ra) narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. al-Hasan al-Husayni narrated to us from al-Hasan b. `Ali from his father from Muhammad b. `Ali from his father al-Rida from his father Musa b. Ja`far from his father Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father Muhammad b. `Ali from his father `Ali b. al-Husayn from his father al-Husayn b. `Ali (as).
He said: Amir al-Mu’minin (as) said: How many heedless people weave a robe to wear, when it is actually his shroud; and build a house to live in, when it is actually the place of his grave.
